non_authority_declaration: Candidate only; no reviewed-gold, promotion, theology, canon, authorship, date, compositional layer, historicity, identity, ethics, divine psychology, covenant doctrine, monarchy judgment, restoration chronology, fulfillment, preferred witness or translation, graph, or retrieval authority.
Local canonical coordinates and WEB wording are navigation and literary evidence only; Hebrew, versional, heading, cross-reference, reception, and agreement evidence cannot authorize a boundary.

validation_metadata.method: expand every proposed span against ordered local canonical coordinates and compare arrays

units.title: Superscription
units.deciding_marker: word-event formula, prophet, and royal synchronisms
units.rejected_alternative: Absorbing the heading into the first sign command obscures the collection frame.
units.risk: Heading decides no authorship, date, reign reconstruction, or compositional unity.

units.title: Enacted household signs and reversed names
units.literary_form: sign narrative with naming speeches and restoration coda
units.deciding_marker: repeated conception-naming sequence completed by reversal of all three names
units.rejected_alternative: Ending at Hos.1.9 or Hos.1.11 detaches reversal from the sign sequence.
units.risk: Marriage ethics, identities, historicity, speakers, and numbering offset remain deferred.

units.title: Contend with the mother
units.deciding_marker: double contend imperative; lovers/provisions accusation; therefore judgments; forgot-me close
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting at Hos.2.6 or Hos.2.9 separates accusation from consequence.
units.risk: Referents, pronouns, sexualized rhetoric, ethics, and divine speech remain deferred.

units.title: Allurement, betrothal, and naming restoration
units.deciding_marker: therefore-behold reversal; wilderness speech; repeated in-that-day and betroth; restored names
units.rejected_alternative: Isolating famous promises detaches them from the full judgment-to-restoration answer.
units.risk: Chronology, marriage metaphor, covenant scope, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Love again: enacted restraint and return
units.deciding_marker: go-again command; purchase; stay speech; explanatory for and afterward return
units.rejected_alternative: Separating Hos.3.4-Hos.3.5 breaks the sign-act and interpretation.
units.risk: Identity, ethics, valuation, royal referent, chronology, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Charge against the land
units.deciding_marker: hear summons; explicit charge; offense list; therefore land mourning
units.rejected_alternative: Joining the priest dispute blurs the land-wide opening charge.
units.risk: Covenant classification and ecological causality are not theological rulings.

units.title: Priest, people, and rejected knowledge
units.deciding_marker: priest/prophet stumble; knowledge-law rejection; like-people-like-priest; understanding refrain
units.rejected_alternative: Atomizing priest sayings or cult imagery detaches leadership failure from ruin.
units.risk: Hos.4.4-Hos.4.5 syntax, addressee, priest identity, gendered accusations, and ethics remain deferred.

units.title: Warning to Judah over stubborn Israel
units.deciding_marker: Israel/Judah vocatives; negative commands; heifer and idol images; wind close
units.rejected_alternative: Merging into Hos.5.1 mutes the warning before the new summons.
units.risk: Addressees, imperative force, place names, and abandonment remain deferred.

units.title: Priests, house, and king under judgment
units.deciding_marker: listen/listen/give-ear; snare accusation; failed seeking; new-moon consequence
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting at Hos.5.3 or Hos.5.5 divides accusation from verdict.
units.risk: Hos.5.1-Hos.5.2 translation, identities, cult practice, and new-moon image remain deferred.

units.title: Alarm, sickness, and the withdrawn lion
units.deciding_marker: trumpets; day of rebuke; moth/rottenness and sickness/wound; lion withdrawal
units.rejected_alternative: Ending at Hos.5.12 detaches the healing attempt and lion response.
units.risk: King Jareb, agency, chronology, and quotation bridge remain deferred.

units.title: Come, let us return
units.deciding_marker: come and let-us imperatives; tear/heal reversal; temporal hope; rain close
units.rejected_alternative: Absorbing into Hos.6.4 obscures the speaker and rhetorical turn.
units.risk: Speaker, sincerity, temporal idiom, resurrection inference, and punctuation remain deferred.

units.title: Vanishing loyalty and uncovered iniquity
units.literary_form: divine reply, indictment, and failed-healing bridge
units.deciding_marker: paired questions; cloud/dew loyalty; mercy/knowledge; heal/restore syntax across chapter seam
units.rejected_alternative: A stop at Hos.6.11 strands the when-I-would-heal clause.
units.risk: Hos.6.5, Hos.6.7, Hos.6.11 syntax, Adam/place, speaker, and restoration sense remain deferred.

units.title: The royal oven
units.literary_form: court indictment through sustained oven imagery
units.deciding_marker: king/princes frame; repeated oven/fire; king day; fallen kings close
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting oven comparisons obscures their cumulative court function.
units.risk: Difficult imagery, sexual metaphor, conspirators, speaker, and rulers remain deferred.

units.title: Mixed among nations, returning to nowhere
units.deciding_marker: cake/dove/bow chain; Egypt-Assyria; repeated no-return/no-cry; derision close
units.rejected_alternative: Separating dove or bow fragments one failed-return movement.
units.risk: Foreign policy, imagery, Most High wording, speaker, and agency remain deferred.

units.title: Trumpet, kings, calf, and whirlwind
units.deciding_marker: trumpet; covenant/law; false acknowledgment; kings and calf; sow-reap climax
units.rejected_alternative: Isolating the sowing proverb detaches it from its accusations.
units.risk: Eagle/house, covenant, royal history, cult, and agency remain deferred.

units.title: Swallowed among nations and estranged from instruction
units.deciding_marker: swallowed/nations; Assyria; altars; written-law rejection; Egypt/fire verdict
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting at Hos.8.10 or Hos.8.11 separates dependence from the verdict.
units.risk: Hos.8.10 gather/oppress polarity, chronology, sacrifice, and speakers remain deferred.

units.title: No festival in exile and the hostile watchman
units.deciding_marker: do-not-rejoice; feast questions; flight/burial; visitation; prophet-watchman and Gibeah
units.rejected_alternative: Ending at Hos.9.6 detaches the feast question from reckoning.
units.risk: Purity, geography, Hos.9.6, prophet identity, hostility, and Gibeah remain deferred.

units.title: First fruit turned fruitless
units.deciding_marker: grapes/fig recollection; Baal Peor; birth/womb/root images; cast-away close
units.rejected_alternative: Separating Gilgal and root stanzas breaks the fruitlessness progression.
units.risk: Cult history, reproductive imagery, violence, prayer, and speakers remain deferred.

units.title: Luxuriant vine, divided heart, and vanished king
units.deciding_marker: vine; altar-stone; no-king saying; calf removal; king-as-twig; mountain plea
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting cult and king images misses their interwoven collapse.
units.risk: Heart translation, calf terminology, royal chronology, and later reuse remain deferred.

units.title: From Gibeah to the final battle roar
units.literary_form: historical accusation, agrarian appeal, and war consequence
units.deciding_marker: Gibeah; heifer/plow/sow-reap; trusted-might reversal; battle and king close
units.rejected_alternative: Isolating Hos.10.12 detaches it from preparation and contrast.
units.risk: Hos.10.10, Gibeah/Shalman/Beth Arbel, speaker, and violence remain deferred.

units.title: The loved child who would not return
units.deciding_marker: child recollection; called/taught/drew/fed; refusal-to-return; sword close
units.rejected_alternative: Ending at Hos.11.4 detaches care from refusal and consequence.
units.risk: Identity, pronouns, Hos.11.3-Hos.11.4, chronology, and divine emotion remain deferred.

units.title: How can I give you up?
units.literary_form: divine compassion soliloquy and return promise
units.deciding_marker: four questions; inward turn; not-destroy; lion roar and trembling return
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting at Hos.11.9 detaches compassion from homecoming.
units.risk: Divine psychology, translation, Admah/Zeboiim, chronology, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Deceit, Jacob struggle, and the call to return
units.literary_form: controversy with ancestral recollection and appeal
units.deciding_marker: accusation across coordinate seam; controversy; Jacob/Bethel; therefore-return
units.rejected_alternative: A chapter stop separates deceit from controversy, recollection, and appeal.
units.risk: Versification, Judah wording, angel/God, quotation, Bethel voice, and chronology remain deferred.

units.title: Dishonest wealth and the prophet-preserved people
units.literary_form: economic indictment, divine answer, and paired recollection
units.deciding_marker: merchant/scales; wealth boast; I-am-Yahweh; prophets; Jacob-wife/Egypt-prophet; repayment
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting the boast loses the divine answer and verdict.
units.risk: Merchant/Canaan, speaker, tents, prophet identity, and history remain deferred.

units.title: From Baal-made death to the attacking animals
units.deciding_marker: Baal death; idols; mist/dew/chaff/smoke; wilderness care; predator consequence
units.rejected_alternative: Ending at Hos.13.3 detaches dissolution from remembered care and reversal.
units.risk: Hos.13.1, sacrifice wording, cult history, identity, violence, and agency remain deferred.

units.title: King, labor, death, and Samaria sentence
units.deciding_marker: destroyed-Israel; king question; stored guilt/labor; Death/Sheol; east wind and Samaria
units.rejected_alternative: Isolating Hos.13.14 suppresses its disputed polarity and context.
units.risk: Hos.13.14 ransom-or-threat, punctuation, kingship, Sheol, violence, and Hebrew 14:1 offset remain deferred.

units.title: Return with words
units.literary_form: return summons and model communal confession
units.deciding_marker: Israel-return; take-words; petition renouncing Assyria, horses, and idols
units.rejected_alternative: Merging into Hos.13.16 mutes the reset; splitting Hos.14.1 detaches supplied words.
units.risk: Versification, speaker, sacrifice wording, political referents, and sincerity remain deferred.

units.title: Healing and flourishing
units.literary_form: divine healing response and botanical restoration poem
units.deciding_marker: I-will-heal; love/anger reversal; dew-lily-Lebanon-olive-vine; idols and fruit coda
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting plant images or Hos.14.8 fragments the response.
units.risk: Speaker/pronouns, botany, chronology, divine emotion, and theology remain deferred.

units.title: Wisdom colophon
units.deciding_marker: wise/prudent questions; understand/know; walking/stumbling maxim
units.rejected_alternative: Absorbing into healing speech obscures generalized reader address and closure.
units.risk: Speaker, redaction, authorship, canon function, and reader identity remain deferred.
